cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 reports a fine, sanction or licence withdrawal for digital financial services under these rules. The payment-services conduct standard was still being drafted in 2025.
cells.note: The National Credit Act's affordability assessment is a conduct rule in force for credit providers, digital lenders included (2026), and the National Financial Ombud takes digital banking complaints, so stage 4. No enforcement decision is held, so not 5.
